lines: The poolside of a hotel in the collapsed city.
After spending about an hour swimming and playing with a ball.
Reika and I got out of the pool and took a break, nibbling on the sandwiches from the bento boxes we had brought.
Reika
Mmm, delicious! Properly cooked meals really are the best!
Reika
Back where I was, it was nothing but survival rations... I was so sick of them!
Me
I know. I sometimes have to live off survival rations on missions too, and it's really tough.
Reika
Right? Besides, unlike Senpai Saeko, who is so detached from the world, I'm just a normal girl.
Reika
Not being able to take a bath every day, not being able to eat good food... that kind of life is definitely miserable!
Me
Y-yes, that's true... By the way, Reika, aren't you on good terms with Saeko?
I had noticed it during yesterday's battle too, but there seemed to be a subtle tension between Reika and Saeko...?
Reika
Huh? N-no, that's not true at all...
Reika
I truly respect her for being amazing... but things have happened, and she is my rival too...
Me
Haa...?
Reika
A-anyway, let's drop that! Here, Fuuma-kun, pour me another cup of tea!
Me
Y-yes, sir!
Reika, looking a bit pouty, thrust the tea cup toward me.
It was probably because I had been acting as her escort and taking care of her for the past few days.
Reika had started showing me her true, unguarded expressions like this.
Me
So, Reika, what are you going to do after you finish eating? Want to swim a bit more?
I asked while pouring tea into Reika's cup.
It was just past noon, so we had plenty of time before heading back.
Reika
Hmm... I've swum enough, so I think I'll take it easy this afternoon. My legs and back are all stiff... Ah, that's it!
Reika
Then, Fuuma-kun, how about you give me a massage?
Me
Eh? A massage...?
You mean the kind where you knead the shoulders and legs and work out the tension in the back muscles...?
Reika
Yes. In that world, I was always on edge and never really got to relax...
Reika
So while I'm here, I want to really loosen up my body!
Reika
Fuuma-kun, you're my escort while I'm here, right? You'll do whatever I say, won't you?
Me
Y-yes, that's right... Is that okay?
If it's a massage, that means I'll be touching Reika's back and shoulders.
Reika
Huh? Are you thinking something weird? I'm so disappointed... I had no idea you were such a pervert...
Me
N-no, I'm fine! Of course, I'm not thinking anything perverted at all!
Reika
Hehe, see? I knew you weren't that kind of person!
Reika
Then, Fuuma-kun, please get ready for the massage right away~
Me
Y-yes...
Seeing me flustered, Reika gave me a mischievous smile.
And then...
Me
Alright, let's begin, Reika.
Reika
Mm. My neck is really stiff, so please focus on that area...
Reika
Ahun!? N-no... That's too... hard... Aah...
Me
Ah!? I'm sorry, I must have been a little too strong. Did it hurt...?
No, no, I seem to have put in too much force.
I hurriedly relaxed the pressure in my fingertips.
Reika was lying face down on a sheet spread out on the pool deck,
and I had just started massaging and working out her shoulders.
Reika
N-no... I just got a little startled, it doesn't hurt, so it's fine...
Reika
Just keep going like that, Fuuma-kun...?
Me
Y-yes... Then, I'll start working it out while applying the oil...?
I said that and began pouring the massage oil I had prepared nearby over Reika's back.
By the way, this oil was something I just took from the hotel's gift shop.
The shop had been trashed beyond recognition by the zombie attack, so the staff almost certainly wouldn't notice,
but I intended to go back and pay for it later, just in case.
Reika
Nnn... Ahh... That's good... Press harder on my back...
Me
Um... Is this the right spot, Reika-san?
With my fingertips slicked in plenty of oil, I began kneading Reika-san's shoulders and back.
Reika
U-uh-huh, yes, that's it... Ahh, what is this... The pressure is... getting better...
Reika
Fuuma-kun, you're surprisingly good at giving massages...?
Reika
Fufu... Do you do this kind of thing for your girlfriend too?
Me
N-no, I don't have a girlfriend, and I don't usually do this sort of thing...
Me
But I study human anatomy as part of my Taimanin training.
Me
So I know a fair amount about pressure points and how to loosen up muscles.
Reika
Hee, is that so... Ahh! Nnn... I think I'm going to get addicted to this...
Me
Ah, um, Reika-san...? I'm flattered by the praise, but
Me
when you make sounds like that, my self-control is...
Reika
Haaauu!? What...? Did you say something, Fuuma-kun... Nnn
Me
N-no, I didn't say anything!
I shook my head vigorously, forcibly banishing the wicked thoughts from my mind.
Reika-san certainly was a stunningly beautiful girl, and the sight of her moaning in pleasure during the massage was so captivating it made my head spin.
Me
(But even so...)
I had been assigned to look after Reika-san as her escort.
I should set aside my desires and focus on healing her.
As I continued the massage while thinking such things, I noticed something.
Me
Reika-san, your body is really tense...
Reika
Huh?
It was probably because she had been surviving in a world where civilization had collapsed, living on the edge.
Her body was rigid with tension, constantly subjected to extreme stress,
It was clearly transmitted through my hands as I continued the massage.
Me
(No, it's not just that...)
Looking closely, I could see numerous small scars on Reika's shoulders and back.
These were likely marks she had acquired while surviving in that other world.
Me
Reika-san, you really fought in a harsh world, didn't you...
I couldn't help but mutter, and Reika gave a tired, wry smile.
Reika
About that world... yes. It really was full of hardships.
Reika
I'm surprised I've survived this long myself.
Me
I suppose so... I've been in dangerous situations many times on Taimanin missions, but
Me
Even so, an abnormal situation that defies common sense like this one is rare.
Just moments ago, someone was laughing next to me, only to turn into "those things"—walking corpses—and attack.
To stop them, you had to destroy their heads or kill them completely once more.
Even if that person was someone close to you.
Reika
That's right... so many people died right in front of my eyes... Important people, and people who weren't...
Reika
I find it strange that I haven't gone crazy myself yet.
Me
If that's the case—
I stopped massaging and asked Reika.
Me
It seems like I'm bringing up yesterday's conversation, but are you really okay with going back to such a harsh world...?
Even if she had knowledge of spear techniques, Reika was still just an ordinary girl.
It felt too cruel for her to survive in a world of zombies. That was what I thought.
However, Reika smiled gently and shook her head.
Reika
...Yes, if I said I wasn't afraid of going back, I think that would be a lie.
Reika
Being chased by 'those things,' running around covered in blood...
Reika
There are no safe places, and you don't know when it will end... Such dark, desperate days.
Reika
...But more than that, I have people who are important to me.
Reika
Friends, comrades, family... And 'that guy'.
Me
"That guy" was probably the man Reika-san was operating alongside in the other world.
Reika
It's scary enough to make my body tremble just thinking about it, but... I'm going back there.
Reika
I'll go back and fight 'them' together with my comrades and family.
Reika
I can't be as bold as 'that person'. It's not very cool. ...But that's just who I am.
Me
It's not uncool at all. I think you're amazing, Reika-san.
Someone without any special power standing up to the despair of the zombie disaster...
I think that takes a great deal of courage and resolve.
Reika
Heh, is that so? Then, to give me the strength to do my best over there, please continue the massage, Fuuma-kun~
Me
Yes! Leave it to me!
So that I could heal Reika-san even a little... I nodded vigorously and pressed firmly on her scarred back.
